text: {"lessons":["Past price changes are random and do not reliably predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves.","A gain in one holding is not by itself a reason to sell; I should consider the position's role, diversification, and my overall plan.","Selling 25 shares of Stock A realized a substantial gain, but I should judge the decision by whether it fits my goals and risk tolerance, not just by the profit versus cost."]}
